name.quote: "Board" means the Arizona state board of nursing.

type.quote: "Board" means the Arizona state board of nursing.

age_minimum.quote: A person who wishes to practice as a certified nursing assistant or a licensed nursing assistant shall be at least sixteen years of age.

degree_required.value: Diploma or degree from an approved registered or practical nursing program
degree_required.quote: The applicant has completed satisfactorily the basic curriculum in an approved registered nursing program and holds a diploma or degree from that program.

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved accrediting agency recognized by the United States Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: A postsecondary educational institution or school in this state that is accredited by an accrediting agency recognized by the United States department of education desiring to conduct a registered nursing, practical nursing, nurse practitioner or clinical nurse specialist program shall apply to the board for approval

exams.name: NCLEX-RN
exams.notes: Examination in subjects relating to the duties and services of a registered nurse as determined by the board
exams.quote: An applicant shall pass an examination in subjects relating to the duties and services of a registered nurse taught in an approved registered nursing program as the board determines.

exams.name: NCLEX-PN
exams.notes: Examination in subjects relating to the duties and services of a practical nurse as determined by the board
exams.quote: An applicant shall pass an examination in subjects relating to the duties and services of a practical nurse taught in an approved practical nursing program as the board determines.

interval_years.quote: a registered and practical nurse licensee shall renew the license every four years on or before April 1.

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice registered nursing to an applicant who has been duly licensed or registered as a registered nurse in another state or a territory of the United States if in the opinion of the board the applicant meets the qualifications required of a registered nurse in this state

requirements.value: Applicant must meet qualifications required of a registered nurse in Arizona; no felony convictions without absolute discharge 3+ years before application; international graduates must submit credential evaluation and meet English proficiency requirements.
requirements.quote: The board may issue a license to practice registered nursing to an applicant who has been duly licensed or registered as a registered nurse in another state or a territory of the United States if in the opinion of the board the applicant meets the qualifications required of a registered nurse in this state pursuant to sections 32-1632 and 32-1633.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for a person who is not licensed or certified under this chapter to: 1. Practice or offer to practice as a registered or practical nurse, registered nurse practitioner, certified nurse midwife or clinical nurse specialist in this state.

credential_type.quote: If an applicant successfully passes the examination and meets the other requirements established pursuant to this chapter, the board shall issue a license to practice registered nursing to the applicant.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for a person who is not licensed or certified under this chapter to: 1. Practice or offer to practice as a registered or practical nurse, registered nurse practitioner, certified nurse midwife or clinical nurse specialist in this state.

title_protection.quote: Only a person who holds a valid and current license to practice registered nursing in this state or in a party state pursuant to section 32-1668 may use the title "nurse", "registered nurse", "graduate nurse" or "professional nurse" or the abbreviation "R.N.".

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for a person who is not licensed or certified under this chapter to: 1. Practice or offer to practice as a registered or practical nurse, registered nurse practitioner, certified nurse midwife or clinical nurse specialist in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud or deceit in obtaining, attempting to obtain, or renewing a license or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing fraud or deceit in obtaining, attempting to obtain or renewing a license or a certificate issued pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a felony or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing a felony, whether or not involving moral turpitude, or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude. In either case, conviction by a court of competent jurisdiction or a plea of no contest is conclusive evidence of the commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting in a criminal abortion or attempting to procure or assist in a criminal abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting in a criminal abortion or attempting, agreeing or offering to procure or assist in a criminal abortion.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct or practice that is or might be harmful or dangerous to the health of a patient or the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct or practice that is or might be harmful or dangerous to the health of a patient or the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being mentally incompetent or physically unsafe to a degree harmful or dangerous to the health of a patient or the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being mentally incompetent or physically unsafe to a degree that is or might be harmful or dangerous to the health of a patient or the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license, certificate, permit or registration denied, suspended, conditioned, limited or revoked in another jurisdiction and not reinstated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license, certificate, permit or registration to practice a health care profession denied, suspended, conditioned, limited or revoked in another jurisdiction and not reinstated by that jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wilfully or repeatedly violating a provision of this chapter or a rule adopted pursuant to this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilfully or repeatedly violating a provision of this chapter or a rule adopted pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating this chapter or a rule that is adopted by the board pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board evidence that a nurse or nursing assistant is incompetent, guilty of unprofessional conduct, or mentally or physically unable to safely practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board any evidence that a registered or practical nurse or a nursing assistant is or may be: (i) Incompetent to practice. (ii) Guilty of unprofessional conduct. (iii) Mentally or physically unable to safely practice nursing or to perform nursing-related duties.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to self-report a conviction for a felony or undesignated offense within ten days after the conviction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to self-report a conviction for a felony or undesignated offense within ten days after the conviction.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating or assisting another to cheat on a licensure or certification examination.

definition_quote.value: Registered nursing includes: diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential health problems; assessing health status; establishing nursing diagnosis; establishing goals; prescribing nursing interventions; delegating; maintaining safe and effective nursing care; evaluating responses; teaching; managing and supervising; consulting and coordinating with other health care professionals; and performing additional acts prescribed by the board.
definition_quote.quote: "Registered nursing" includes the following: (a) Diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential health problems. (b) Assisting individuals and groups to maintain or attain optimal health by implementing a strategy of care to accomplish defined goals and evaluating responses to care and treatment. (c) Assessing the health status of individuals and groups.

methods_authorized.quote: "Registered nursing" includes the following: (a) Diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential health problems. (b) Assisting individuals and groups to maintain or attain optimal health by implementing a strategy of care to accomplish defined goals and evaluating responses to care and treatment. (c) Assessing the health status of individuals and groups. (d) Establishing a nursing diagnosis. (e) Establishing goals to meet identified health care needs. (f) Prescribing nursing interventions to implement a strategy of care. (g) Delegating nursing interventions to others who are qualified to do so. (h) Providing for the maintenance of safe and effective nursing care that is rendered directly or indirectly. (i) Evaluating responses to interventions. (j) Teaching nursing knowledge and skills. (k) Managing and supervising the practice of nursing. (l) Consulting and coordinating with other health care professionals in the management of health care.

drug_authority.value: Registered nurse practitioners and certified nurse midwives may prescribe, administer and dispense therapeutic measures including legend drugs, medical devices and controlled substances within their scope of practice after meeting board requirements. Clinical nurse specialists may prescribe and dispense pharmacological agents subject to requirements and limits specified in section 32-1651.
drug_authority.quote: Diagnosing, performing diagnostic and therapeutic procedures, and prescribing, administering and dispensing therapeutic measures, including legend drugs, medical devices and controlled substances within the scope of registered nurse practitioner practice on meeting the requirements established by the board.

license_tiers.quote: "Practical nurse" means a person who holds a practical nurse license issued pursuant to this chapter... "Registered nurse" or "professional nurse" means a person who practices registered nursing and who holds a registered nurse license issued pursuant to this chapter... "Registered nurse practitioner" means a registered nurse who: (a) Is certified by the board... "Certified nurse midwife" means a registered nurse who: (a) Is certified by the board... "Clinical nurse specialist" means a registered nurse who: (a) Is certified by the board as a clinical nurse specialist... "Certified registered nurse anesthetist" means a registered nurse who meets the requirements of section 32-1634.03

aprn_role_categories.quote: Registered nurse practitioner, certified nurse midwife or clinical nurse specialist practice by duly enrolled students under competent supervision as part of a registered nurse practitioner, certified nurse midwife or clinical nurse specialist program

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Practical nursing" includes the following activities that are performed under the supervision of a physician or a registered nurse:

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: Making independent decisions in solving complex patient care problems.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: Making independent decisions in solving complex patient care problems.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: The board shall grant to a clinical nurse specialist the privileges to prescribe and dispense pharmacological agents if the clinical nurse specialist has both of the following: 1. The education and training equivalent to the requirements to prescribe and dispense pharmacological agents of a registered nurse practitioner... 2. Certification as a clinical nurse specialist by a nationally recognized certification entity approved by the board.

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: Adopt rules that prohibit registered nurse practitioners, clinical nurse specialists or certified nurse midwives from dispensing a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid, except for an implantable device or an opioid that is for medication-assisted treatment for substance use disorders or as provided in section 32-3248.03.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Registered nurse practitioners, clinical nurse specialists, and certified nurse midwives are prohibited from dispensing a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid, except for an implantable device or an opioid for medication-assisted treatment for substance use disorders. Clinical nurse specialists in certain institutional settings may not prescribe schedule II opioids except pursuant to institutional protocols or standing orders.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Adopt rules that prohibit registered nurse practitioners, clinical nurse specialists or certified nurse midwives from dispensing a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid, except for an implantable device or an opioid that is for medication-assisted treatment for substance use disorders or as provided in section 32-3248.03.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: "Registry of nursing assistants" means the nursing assistants registry maintained by the board pursuant to the omnibus budget reconciliation act of 1987

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: "Delegation" means transferring to a competent individual the authority to perform a selected nursing task in a designated situation in which the nurse making the delegation retains accountability for the delegation.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: A regulated party and a health care institution as defined in section 36-401 shall, and any other person may, report to the board any information the licensee, certificate holder, health care institution or individual may have that appears to show that a regulated party or applicant is, was or may be a threat to the public health or safety.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The board may establish a confidential program for monitoring licensees who are chemically dependent and who enroll in rehabilitation programs that meet the criteria established by the board.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: A certified registered nurse anesthetist may administer anesthetics under the direction of and in the presence of a physician or surgeon in connection with the preoperative, intraoperative or postoperative care of a patient

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: in a licensed hospital or hospital-affiliated outpatient treatment center, a behavioral health inpatient facility, a nursing care institution, a recovery care center, a behavioral health residential facility or a hospice, the clinical nurse specialist may prescribe or dispense only pursuant to the protocols or standards applicable to clinical nurse specialists of the health care institution

military_education_credit_required.quote: Has completed a military program of basic medical training and was awarded a military occupational specialty and performed in that occupational specialty at a level that is substantially equivalent to the academic requirements for a license to practice as a practical nurse
